question: Do ACLED's cursor and offset pagination return the same events?
method: Harvest one slice twice against live ACLED -- once by &page=N terminating on a short or empty page (frozen copy of the pre-#487 production loop), once by &cursor=X terminating only on next_cursor is None. Compare on four independent oracles: event count, event_id_cnty set, full-record equality over the sorted lists, and the content_digest the ingestion ledger records. A detection drill runs first as a precondition.
